meta.title: Modo - The 2 Types of Labor - MOTION + captions

_note: Captioned variant of the pure motion reel: same scenes/timings, script lines burned as word-by-word captions low in frame (clears the centered animation).

beats.caption: Two types of labor disguise themselves as work.
Building something no one asked for.
Perfecting something no one will see.
Both feel like progress. Neither is.
Product and marketing aren't a split — they're a seesaw.
Flip the order: market and sell before you build.
The market gets a vote. And that feels scary.
But the verdict isn't the enemy. The silence is.
Construct it. Ship it. Take the reps. It's a game of doing.
